versions.description_html:
Learn how Microsoft Entra Agent ID gives AI agents their own identity, securing your tenant with blueprints, lifecycle governance, and least privilege.

Somewhere in your Microsoft 365 tenant, an AI agent is signing in with an account nobody can name. It reads your mail, opens your files, and answers questions in Teams, and when something goes wrong, there's no person on the other end to ask.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • The Agent Nobody Can Name
  • Why Agents Need Their Own Identity
  • What An Agent Identity Actually Is
  • Blueprints: One Template, Many Agents
  • Agent Identities vs Service Principals vs Managed Identities
  • Conditional Access For Agents
  • Governing The Agent Lifecycle
  • Least Privilege, Explained Simply
  • The Pitfalls That Catch People Out
  • The Recap And One Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM

  • Agent Governance Explained- How IT Can Enable the AI Agent Revolution with Thomas Zou [Microsoft]
